# [WP Workbench version 2.1.4 released](https://forum.virtualmin.com/t/wp-workbench-version-2-1-4-released/137640)


[News](https://forum.virtualmin.com/c/news/5)


[pro-only](https://forum.virtualmin.com/tag/pro-only)


[Ilia](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/Ilia)


July 25, 2026, 1:27pm 1


Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out WP Workbench 2.1.4 plugin for all Virtualmin Pro users.


Changes since 2.1.3:


- Fix scheduled backups when files change during archiving


Changes since 2.1.2:


- Fix issue that could incorrectly identify a WordPress site as being hosted on another server
